name: Indonesia
intro: Discover the Island of the Gods, a tropical sanctuary of ancient spirituality, verdant rice terraces, and dramatic coastline surf. Bali is a peaceful retreat for body and soul.
weather: Tropical warm climate. Average temperature stays around 28°C. Wet monsoon season is October to March; dry season is April to September.
visaInfo: 30-day Visa-on-arrival is available for travelers from over 85 countries.
flightDuration: Approx 7-9 hours flight from major Indian airports.
highlights: Wander the cascading emerald rice terraces in Ubud
Participate in a sacred water purification ritual at Tirta Empul temple
Watch the sunset from cliffside Uluwatu Temple
Relax in isolated luxury villas overlooking jungle ravines

famousPlaces.name: Ubud Jungle Sanctuary
famousPlaces.shortDesc: The cultural and spiritual heart of Bali, surrounded by dense jungle ravines and cascading rice paddies.
famousPlaces.overview: Ubud is a center of traditional dance, crafts, and holistic wellness. Fringed by steep ravines and lush rainforest, it provides a quiet escape with wellness retreats, art galleries, and monkey forest paths.

hotels.name: Mandapa, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve
hotels.description: Ultra-luxury sanctuary along the Ayung River in Ubud, featuring private villas.

famousPlaces.meals: Organic farm-to-table breakfasts and traditional Balinese dinners.
famousPlaces.transport: Private AC SUV with dedicated English-speaking local driver.
famousPlaces.activities: Tegallalang Rice Terrace Walk, Tirta Empul Blessing, Ubud Art Market Guide.

faqs.q: What should I wear to Balinese temples?
faqs.a: Both men and women must wear a sarong and sash, which are typically available to rent at the temple entrance.

reviews.author: Meera P.
reviews.text: The purification ritual at Tirta Empul was an incredibly moving spiritual experience.

itinerary.title: Jungle Check-in & Ubud Walk
itinerary.morning: Airport pickup and drive to Ubud. Settle into Mandapa Reserve.
itinerary.afternoon: Stroll the sacred Monkey Forest sanctuary and shop at the local Art Market.
itinerary.evening: Enjoy an authentic crispy duck dinner overlooking the Ayung River.

itinerary.title: Tegallalang & Tirta Empul Blessing
itinerary.morning: Walk the scenic trails of Tegallalang Rice Terraces in morning light.
itinerary.afternoon: Visit Tirta Empul for a guided water purification blessing.
itinerary.evening: Private sound healing session at a wellness dome.
